parts:

messages.subject: Re: Shiny Debugging : Error: object '.setDummyField' not found
parts:
Hi-  You need to update to the latest version of R, 3.0.2.

We've seen this error happen when people used the CRAN version of Shiny, which was built on R 3.0.1 at the time, but they were running R 3.0.0.

-Winston
